name: Button
description: A native button or explicit link action with shared variants, sizes, content regions, and busy semantics.

size.description: Shared control height and spacing scale.

type.description: Native button type in button mode; ignored in link mode.

href.description: A non-empty link destination switches the semantic root to an anchor.

disabled.description: Prevents activation using native or link-mode disabled semantics.

loading.description: Exposes busy state, prevents activation, and renders a progress indicator.

default.description: Accessible action label and primary content.

leading.description: Decorative or labelled content before the action label.

trailing.description: Decorative or labelled content after the action label.

click.description: Native click activation from the enabled semantic root.
